record_kind: Session 036 development closure audit with implemented offline product seams and explicit ordinary blockers
classification_rule: Allowed post-development classifications cannot truthfully classify unresolved ordinary engineering. Such capabilities have null classification and explicit blocker IDs. No readiness declaration is permitted.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.capability: Fresh Windows installer and bundled runtime
ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: Existing spec packages observer/projection only; no installer or complete public runtime bundle. Existing dependency lock targets manylinux.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Implement Windows wheel-only locks, complete bundle, per-user installer, manifests/signing and native validation harness.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: Desktop requires externally started projection port/token. Provider secrets are supplied through broker environment; no first-run protected secret surface exists.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Add immutable non-secret run profiles, Windows protected secret backend and usable setup/run controls.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: No installed launcher creates a run and starts public acquisition, writer, projection and optional broker together. Default production factory consumes indexed archives.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Compose existing public factory under one deterministic launcher; preserve run identity, recovery epochs, stop/resume/export.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: Repository has a thread RLock but no process-level exclusive writer lock.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Acquire a cross-platform OS lock before writable DB initialization; release on close and failed initialization; prove duplicate-writer exclusion.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: M15 source reconstructs history, takes bars[-1], and silently skips triggers older than five seconds. Native M1 durable origin accounting does not cover this path.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Persist every relevant M15 origin or explicit missed/late missingness with stable revision identity and bounded restart-safe paging.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: M15 universe/CandidateSet publication is timestamped at cutoff. M0 requires action.available_at_ns <= market cutoff although action is derived after sizing.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Separate market cutoff from real stage computation/publication time throughout composition and validators. Preserve source cutoff/deadline and frozen hashes; no backdating.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.capability: Meaningful negative and missing decision states
ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: An empty ranking becomes NO_CANDIDATE; missing joins or prerequisites can return no candidates without an explicit sleeve-level missingness result.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Retain typed per-sleeve opportunity results distinguishing valid no-signal from missing/unsupported inputs.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: Resolvers require indexed risk/account/fee/stress/capability and event/candidate-specific economic inputs; indexing helpers have no production publishers. M0 is called by evaluation_service, but fresh public composition cannot supply its required inputs.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Add explicit versioned zero-authority research assumptions and supported evidence publishers. Keep unknown account/execution evidence unsupported and never fabricate capital qualification.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: Production unconditionally emits NO_COMPATIBLE_MATURED_ANALOGUES instead of invoking implemented retrieval.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Connect compatible cutoff-matured analogue query/estimation; retain genuine insufficient-support failures.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: Maturity resolves preexisting actual/replay/diagnostic evidence. No production caller was found for diagnostic target indexing or the missing later-market-to-replay producer.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Produce bounded, exact-decision/action-linked diagnostic outcomes and supported counterfactual replay from later archived evidence; preserve unresolved execution/cost ambiguity.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: REST recovery requires trade_continuity_proven, permanently false for current source. Unsupported trade completeness can prevent independent bar-based sleeves recovering.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Scope recovery to actual required capabilities; retain missing origins and keep S3 completeness fail-closed.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.capability: Provider-neutral S3 completeness and repair port
ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: Forward evidence is explicitly Bybit-specific and forbids completeness. No integrated generic completeness-capable source/repair interface was identified.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Add the smallest typed completeness/coverage/repair boundary and exact lineage checks. Current Bybit remains NOT ESTIMABLE / TEST GATE.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: Research worker requires Linux resource/bubblewrap/mount/preexec behavior. Broker channel and resource lookup assume Unix/source tree.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Implement equivalent enforced Windows isolation and bounded capability transport; bundle-resource lookup. Weakening worker isolation would require a separately reviewed amendment.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: Model Arena/provider ABI exists but scouts found no production composition caller. Exact sealed payload binding and bounded identity caches require review.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Wire explicit registered research-only model configurations, persist exact input/model/config identities, fail closed with no fallback, bound retention.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: History scans all archive files/rows before slicing; hard bounds eventually terminate reconstruction. Broker starts a daemon thread per accepted connection. Scouts also identified growing cursor/model caches.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Use indexed bounded retrieval, bounded broker admission/cache retention, observable disk/archive/SQLite/WAL behavior and stop-on-pressure semantics.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.capability: Compact automatic tuning exports and reports
ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: Existing evidence/maintenance reports do not provide an installed periodic decision-centric compact export/report lifecycle.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Add read-only snapshot/batched Parquet exports, validated outcome joins, full denominators/missingness, resource/provider diagnostics and restart-safe report manifests.

ordinary_engineering_blockers.capability: Complete composition/fault/quality audit and final validation
ordinary_engineering_blockers.finding: Whole-system audit and implementation were interrupted before closure. No new runtime fault or regression tests were executed.
ordinary_engineering_blockers.required: Finish principal audit, implement fixes, review full diff and run required focused/full/static/dependency/freeze/secret gates once implementation is frozen.
